notes.title: Setting Up the Perfect Restaurant Interior! 🍔✨
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Fast Food Fans! 👋[/h1]
In our last devlog, we talked about the essential renovations needed before opening the restaurant doors. Now that the remodeling is complete, it’s time to bring our restaurant to life! 🌟
After finishing the construction, it's crucial to equip the kitchen with the necessary appliances to meet all health and safety standards. 🧼💡 This means selecting high-quality kitchen equipment and arranging it to be functional and convenient for the staff. An efficient kitchen setup is key to delivering tasty meals quickly! 🍕🍟
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018140/605b3ad17c8bf92bb554a23998e106dbf5fe21b1.gif[/img]
But of course, our guests' experience goes beyond the kitchen. To make sure everyone feels welcome from the moment they walk in, we need to create a warm and inviting atmosphere in the dining area. This includes carefully choosing wall colors, cozy wallpapers, comfortable seating, and lighting that sets the right mood. 🛋️🖼️💡 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018140/b5a1c35321be1297cf32d7c14c6216a66c70687d.gif[/img]
Every detail—from chairs and tables to decorative accents—should work together to form a harmonious space where guests feel at ease.

[b]Thank you for following our progress as we build the ultimate fast-food experience! 🙏 Be sure to keep an eye out for future devlogs where we’ll share more updates on the game’s development. And don’t miss out on the Culinary Festival on Steam starting today! 🎉 We invite you all to join in the celebration![/b]

[b][u]Happy gaming and see you in the next devlog![/u] 🎮🍔
[/b]

notes.title: First Task - Renovating the Restaurant
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Fast Food enthusiasts![/h1]
In today's update, we want to share some exciting news about one of the first key tasks you'll face as the new owner of a rundown restaurant: the renovation!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018140/c631e1f9bc108b8c41935f97db4bd93eaa7c2e11.gif[/img]
When you first take over the restaurant, things will be in bad shape. Your first job will be to turn that around, and it won’t be a simple paint job. You’ll have to roll up your sleeves and get to work, both inside and outside the building. This means clearing out debris, removing trash, and fixing up areas that have seen better days. In some cases, you might even have to knock down walls to open up space and make way for something better.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018140/84c340784383afb94e4ebe1e5164949f14a1195d.gif[/img]
The renovation process is more than just a cosmetic makeover. How you manage the restoration will directly affect how well your restaurant does. If you play your cards right, your restaurant will become a welcoming spot for customers, as well as a thriving business. Good management will bring you profit, but also transform the place into a cozy meeting point for the local community.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018140/6ecbe3c79c537d38677a1ccd4c584a2e1b7837eb.gif[/img]
However, don’t think that after the renovation everything will run smoothly. One wrong hire can lead to disaster! For example, if you bring in an unqualified electrician, your entire electrical system could go up in flames, literally, and take your business down with it. Renovating is just the start of your entrepreneurial journey—you’ll need to stay sharp as the new restaurant owner!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018140/41236966c8bcb5efdee31befcdca589058fc532d.gif[/img]
Before we wrap up, we want to thank all of our amazing fans for your continued support. You've helped make this project a reality, and we can't wait for you to experience Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator. Be sure to check out Universum Gas Station on Steam as well, where you'll find other great titles—perhaps even at a nice discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35934053/sale/GasStationSimulator3rdAnniversary
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35934053/sale/GasStationSimulator3rdAnniversary][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32657471/66f4dc8a2da08d97143bd1645d510a47ae711ab4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Stay tuned for more updates, and happy renovating![/h2]

notes.title: Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator: Drive-Thru and Beyond
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Restaurateurs![/h1]
We’re excited to share some tasty updates about our upcoming game, Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator! As you know, running a successful fast food joint isn't just about flipping burgers and frying fries. Today, we want to give you a sneak peek into one of the unique features we’re developing for our game: the drive-thru experience.
[h2]Drive-Thru Dynamics[/h2]
In Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator, the drive-thru will be a bustling hub of activity. As orders come in, you’ll have the chance to observe a variety of vehicles pulling up to your window. From flashy sports cars to humble family vans, each vehicle will add to the dynamic atmosphere of your restaurant. Your goal? To keep the line moving quickly and efficiently while ensuring every customer leaves happy and satisfied.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018140/2d528869709d8c78a129dec5d14cbe665da79296.jpg[/img]
[h2]Parking Lot Panorama[/h2]
But the drive-thru isn’t the only place you’ll see vehicles. Our game will also feature a detailed parking lot where you can spot different cars during your breaks. Take a moment to relax and enjoy the view of the cars parked outside, adding an extra layer of realism and immersion to your restaurant management experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45018140/3d0625932f88b783a8207c47ae1f846b4df602a1.gif[/img]
[h2]And More to Come…[/h2]
This is just a taste of what Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator will offer. We’re continually working to add more features and improvements to make your restaurant management journey as engaging and enjoyable as possible. Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to serve up some delicious fun!

[b]Before we sign off, we have some exciting news! Our talented colleagues have just released a teaser for Car Dealer Simulator. Check it out on the game's Steam page and get a sneak peek at what’s coming next![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/
[u]Stay hungry and keep those orders coming!
The Fast Food - Restaurant Simulator Team[/u]
